cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
library(meta)
library(tidyverse)
df <- read.csv('/data/preregSR_dataClean.csv')
df$disclosedNum <- as.numeric(df$disclosedNum)
dfMeta <- df %>% filter(!is.na(disclosedNum))
meta <- meta::metaprop(dfMeta$disclosedNum, dfMeta$disclosedDenom, method='GLMM', method.tau='ML', method.tau.ci='J', comb.random=TRUE, prediction=TRUE, level.predict=0.95, hakn=TRUE)
cat('k=', meta$k, '\n')
cat('sum(meta$n)=', sum(meta$n), '\n')
cat('meta$n.e? ', paste(meta$n.e, collapse=','), '\n')
cat('meta$n.c? ', paste(meta$n.c, collapse=','), '\n')
cat('dfMeta rows=', nrow(dfMeta), '\n')
RS
